header.title: Sign in
header.headline: Play Magic online, free, with anyone.

action.registerHint: Free, on the server you pick

status.serverUnreachable: Trouble reaching the server. Wait a minute and try again.
status.passwordChangeRequired: An administrator has reset your password. The server will not sign you in until you choose a new one: use “Forgot password?” to set it, then sign in with the new password.
status.serverFull: The server has reached its maximum number of users. Please check back later.
status.passwordRequired: Please enter your password to sign in again. Your saved credentials cannot be used for this account.
status.authenticationUnsupported: The server requested authentication settings this client cannot safely use. Login was stopped.
status.tooManyRequests: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
status.tooManyRequestsUntil: Too many login attempts. Please try again after {until}.
